rec.name: Competitor Comparison Table (Us vs. Other Providers vs. Freelancers)

what.text: A feature-comparison table with a highlighted brand column (green, rounded) next to two competitor columns, 'Other providers' and 'Freelancers'. Each row is a benefit or feature (e.g. A/B-tested sections, built by Shopify Plus devs, extensive video guides, easy integration, free updates, free post-install review, German premium support). The brand column shows a check in every row. Competitor columns mostly show red crosses, with a few green checks where the competitor genuinely delivers. Rows alternate in background shade for readability.

why.text: Side-by-side comparison makes the brand's differentiators easy to scan and reduces the effort of comparing alternatives. The highlighted column anchors attention on the recommended option. Check/cross iconography gives an instant good-vs-bad read, and a few honest competitor checks keep it credible. It also reduces perceived risk by answering 'why you and not a cheaper alternative or a freelancer?'

how.text: Build a custom section with a header row (empty label cell plus three column titles) and repeatable row blocks (label plus a check/cross state per column). Render the first data column inside a full-height, rounded, accent-coloured highlight. Use alternating row backgrounds with rounded corners. Column titles must share one style, with no text outlines or outlined icons. Use identical icon sizes and vertically centre all icons in each row, because the review found the check sitting lower than the crosses on both desktop and mobile. On mobile the table stays three-column and scrolls horizontally, keeping the highlighted column in view.

items: Per-row, per-column state: check or cross
Highlight colour for the brand column
Check and cross icon colours (brand check vs. green competitor check vs. red cross)

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields evident. It needs a dark or light theme with a customisable accent colour and an SVG icon set for checks and crosses. Row text is plain, so it must be translatable if the shop is multilingual. The mobile screenshot also shows a sticky glass header and a countdown announcement bar, which are not part of this element.

items: Click-through from the section to CTA or PDP
Add-to-cart rate for sessions that saw the section
Bounce / exit rate on the host page

images.caption: Desktop: highlighted green brand column, two competitor columns, alternating rows, and check/cross icons. Annotations flag outlined heading/check styling and misaligned icons in the last row.
Mobile: the table is horizontally scrollable with the highlighted brand column centred; the red line marks check/cross misalignment in the last row.
